intents.label: Baggage Allowance
phrases: how many kilos can I check in
how much luggage am I allowed to carry
what's the weight limit for check-in luggage
how many bags can I bring on board
what is the cabin baggage weight limit
how much does an extra bag cost
intents.response: Economy passengers get 23kg checked baggage and 1 cabin bag up to 7kg. Business class allows 32kg checked. Extra bags can be added at booking or at the airport for a fee.

intents.label: Flight Status
phrases: what is the status of flight KQ100
intents.response: Please share your flight number and I can pull the latest departure and arrival status for you (demo: live status lookup would connect to the ops system).

intents.label: Booking Change
phrases: I want to change my flight date
how do I change my ticket
can I move my flight to next week
how much does it cost to change a flight
intents.response: You can change your booking through Manage My Booking on our website, or I can start the change request here. Date changes may incur a fare difference plus a change fee, depending on your ticket type.

intents.label: Check-in Process
phrases: how do I check in for my flight
can I check in from my phone
do I need to check in early
how early should I arrive for check-in
intents.response: Online check-in opens 48 hours before departure and closes 90 minutes prior. Airport counters open 3 hours before departure and close 60 minutes before. You can check in via our app, website, or airport kiosk.

intents.label: Refund Policy
phrases: how do I get a refund
can I get my money back for a cancelled flight
how long does a refund take
intents.response: Refund eligibility depends on your fare class. Refundable tickets are processed within 7-14 business days back to the original payment method. I can start a refund request if you share your booking reference.

intents.label: Lost Baggage
phrases: baggage did not show up on the belt
how do I report lost baggage
bag was damaged during the flight
intents.response: I'm sorry about your baggage. Please file a Property Irregularity Report at the airport baggage desk or online within 7 days. Share your baggage tag number and I can start tracking it for you.

intents.label: Seat Selection
phrases: how do I choose my seat
can I select an aisle seat
can I sit with my family
intents.response: You can select or change your seat through Manage My Booking up to check-in. Extra-legroom and window/aisle preferences may carry an additional fee depending on fare class.

intents.label: Delay Compensation
phrases: am I entitled to compensation for a delayed flight
flight was delayed for 5 hours what can I claim
can I get a refund for a long delay
missed connection due to delay compensation
what happens if my flight is delayed
intents.response: Compensation depends on the delay length, cause, and route regulations. For delays over 3 hours we typically offer meal vouchers and, where applicable, accommodation. Share your flight number and I'll check your specific entitlement.

intents.label: Travel Documents
phrases: what documents do I need to travel
do I need a visa for this destination
what ID do I need for domestic flight
intents.response: Document requirements vary by destination and nationality. Generally your passport should be valid for at least 6 months beyond travel. Tell me your destination and nationality and I'll check specific visa/entry requirements.

intents.label: Loyalty Program
phrases: how to redeem miles for a flight
how many miles do I have
intents.response: You earn miles based on fare class and distance flown. Miles can be redeemed for flight awards, upgrades, or partner rewards. Log in to your loyalty account or share your membership number for a balance check.

intents.label: Shift Schedule
phrases: what is my shift schedule this week
what time does my shift start
am I on morning or night shift
intents.response: Your shift schedule is published on the internal rostering portal a week in advance. Share your staff ID and I can pull your upcoming shifts for you.

intents.label: Leave Request
phrases: how do I apply for leave
how many leave days do I have left
how to file for shift leave
intents.response: Leave requests are submitted through the HR self-service portal at least 2 weeks in advance for annual leave. I can show your current leave balance if you share your staff ID.

intents.label: HR Policy
phrases: what is the dress code policy
intents.response: HR policies are documented in the Employee Handbook on the internal portal. I can summarize the specific policy you're asking about, or point you to the exact handbook section.

intents.label: Payroll Query
phrases: when will I be paid this month
how to update my bank details for payroll
intents.response: Salaries are processed on the last working day of the month. For payslip access or discrepancies, I can direct you to the payroll self-service portal or flag this for the payroll team.

intents.label: Uniform Guidelines
phrases: where do I order my uniform
how to request a new uniform size
intents.response: Uniform orders and replacements are handled through the uniform services desk. I can help you start a replacement request or share the grooming standards document.

intents.label: Training Schedule
phrases: when is my next recurrent training
how do I book a training session
training module not showing on portal
where do I complete online training
intents.response: Recurrent and mandatory training schedules are posted on the Learning Management portal. Share your staff ID and I can check your next due date and compliance status.

intents.label: Internal IT Support
phrases: I cannot log into the staff portal
printer not working in the office
system error on the internal app
intents.response: For IT issues, I can log a helpdesk ticket now, or you can reach the IT helpdesk directly for urgent outages. Can you describe the exact error you're seeing?

intents.label: Emergency Protocol
phrases: what is the emergency evacuation procedure
who do I contact during an operational emergency
fire safety procedure at the office
what to do during a security threat
intents.response: Emergency protocols are detailed in the Operations Safety Manual. For an active emergency, always contact the duty operations manager immediately at the emergency line rather than relying on this chat.

intents.label: Performance Review
phrases: how to dispute a performance rating
intents.response: Performance reviews follow the annual appraisal cycle, with self-assessments due before your manager review. I can share the current cycle's key dates.

intents.label: Shift Swap
phrases: can I swap my shift with a colleague
how to request a shift exchange
trade shifts with another staff member
find someone to cover my shift
intents.response: Shift swaps can be requested on the rostering portal and require supervisor approval at least 48 hours in advance. I can help you start a swap request now.
